entities.summary: Hans Åke Jonsson is a Swedish former professional ice hockey player. He played in the National Hockey League with the Pittsburgh Penguins from 1999 to 2003. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1992 to 2011, was mainly spent with Modo Hockey in the Swedish Elitserien. Internationally Jonsson played for the Swedish national team at three World Championships, winning a gold medal in 1998 and a bronze in 1999.
